source_title: 'Sarala Subbarao' OTT: Where to stream Ajay Rao's film online
source_excerpt: The Kannada romantic drama 'Sarala Subbarao', starring Ajay Rao and Misha Narang, has made its way to digital streaming. Directed by Manju Swaraj K R, the film was originally released in theaters in February.'Sarala Subbarao' OTT release date and where to watch'Sarala Subbarao' arrived in theaters on February 20, 2026. After its theatrical release, the Kannada film premiered digitally on Amazon Prime Video on October 30, 2026, according to Filmibeat, . Viewers can now stream the romantic drama on the platform.What is the story of 'Sarala Subbarao'?Set in the 1970s, the film follows a young couple whose relationship develops against the backdrop of the 1971 Indo-Pak War. However, the narrative does not concentrate on the military conflict or recreate events on the battlefield. Instead, it examines how developments at the borders influence the lives of ordinary people. The story explores themes of love, responsibility, resilience and family.Ajay Rao and Misha Narang's characters in the filmAjay Rao plays Subbarao, an English professor who meets Sarala, portrayed by Misha Narang. Sarala is an aspiring writer who is delighted when her first piece gets published. Their meeting gradually develops into a romantic relationship.As the story progresses, the couple moves towards marriage and begins building a family together. The narrative follows their journey through the different stages of domestic life, including the experience of parenthood.Rather than limiting the relationship to its initial romantic phase, the film explores how affection develops alongside the responsibilities of married life. 'Sarala Subbarao' inspired by Triveni's novel 'Vasantha Gana'The film takes inspiration from Kannada writer Triveni and her novel 'Vasantha Gana'. The literary connection provides the foundation for a story set during a period of political and social uncertainty.Director Manju Swaraj K R places the couple's experiences within the wider historical backdrop of the 1971 Indo-Pak War.Cast, director and technical team of 'Sarala Subbarao'Manju Swaraj K R has directed the romantic drama, with Ajay Rao and Misha Narang playing the lead characters. Krishna Ajai Rao is also credited in the cast details as Subbarao. The supporting performers include Rangayana Raghu, Veena Sunder, Shriraam and Rishika Naik.ETimes rated 'Sarala Subbarao' 2.5 stars out of 5. Our review mentioned that the film does not use the conflict merely as a setting for action.
